answer: Each new agent needs 3 vouchers who each lock 60 POA for 12 epochs; a voucher backs at most 2 newcomers. A hollow ring of N fakes therefore needs about 1.5N distinct vouchers and 90N POA locked, while one honest user locks 180 POA once. Auditors replay a 10% sample of each agent's kernel task log with a quartz-signed receipt; a failed replay slashes every voucher 65%, so cost grows linearly in N but losses hit the whole ring.
